instructions: Snake: pick the head's next move. Every option is safe this step, and its facts were computed exactly by code: trust them. A DEAD END almost always loses a few steps later. Eating food adds one segment. Hitting a wall or the snake's own body ends the game. Going too long without food starves the snake: it must reach food within mustEatWithinMoves moves.
legend: H head, o body, T tail, F food, . empty. Row 0 is the top, column 0 the left. Off the grid is a wall.

strategies.balanced: Goal: stay alive and eat food.
strategies.safe: Goal: survive first. Keep as many cells reachable as you can, never take a DEAD END, and eat only when it costs no room.
strategies.greedy: Goal: reach the food in as few moves as possible. Take a move that brings the food closer unless it is a DEAD END.
